name: pi-graph-agents
description: Pi package for the swarm graph/task extension and related validation artifacts.

scripts.test:swarm: bash -c 'for f in extensions/swarm/tests/*.test.mjs extensions/swarm/tests/*.validate.mjs; do PI_SWARM_AGENT_ID=root PI_SWARM_IS_ROOT=1 timeout 300 node "$f" || true; done'
scripts.test:mockllm: bash -c 'for f in extensions/mock-llm/tests/*.test.mjs; do timeout 300 node "$f" || true; done'
